title: STAS Capacity Planning
description: Daily capacity tracking: fixes, storage, queue, workers, API calls, costs, projections

panels.title: Daily Fixes
panels.description: Total fix runs per day with success/failure breakdown

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", fix_total_runs AS "Total Runs", fix_successful_runs AS "Successful", fix_failed_runs AS "Failed" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date

panels.title: Storage Growth
panels.description: Database and log storage consumption over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", storage_db_size_bytes AS "DB Size", storage_log_size_bytes AS "Log Size", storage_total_bytes AS "Total" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date

panels.title: Queue Depth & Throughput
panels.description: Queue depth (current and max) and throughput per minute

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", queue_current_depth AS "Current Depth", queue_max_depth AS "Max Depth" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date
SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", queue_throughput_per_minute AS "Throughput/min" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date

panels.title: Worker Health
panels.description: Active workers, crashed workers, and concurrent tasks

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", worker_active_workers AS "Active", worker_crashed_workers AS "Crashed", worker_max_concurrent_tasks AS "Max Concurrent" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date

panels.title: API Request Volume & Latency
panels.description: API request count and latency percentiles

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", api_total_requests AS "Requests" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date
SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", api_p50_latency_ms AS "P50", api_p95_latency_ms AS "P95", api_p99_latency_ms AS "P99" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date

panels.title: Daily Costs
panels.description: Daily cost breakdown by component (model, sandbox, compute)

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", cost_total_millicents / 100000.0 AS "Total ($)", cost_model_millicents / 100000.0 AS "Model ($)", cost_sandbox_millicents / 100000.0 AS "Sandbox ($)", cost_compute_millicents / 100000.0 AS "Compute ($)" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date

panels.title: 90-Day Projections
panels.description: Historical data with linear projections for fixes, costs, storage

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", fix_total_runs AS "Actual Fixes" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date
SELECT snapshot_date AS "time", cost_total_millicents / 100000.0 AS "Actual Cost ($)" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date

panels.title: Capacity Health Status
panels.description: Disk growth rate, cost trend, fix growth rate indicators

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Disk Growth' AS "metric", LEAST(100, (storage_growth_bytes_24h::float / NULLIF(storage_total_bytes, 0)) * 100 * 30) AS "value" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 'Cost Trend' AS "metric", CASE WHEN cost_avg_per_fix_millicents > 0 AND LAG(cost_avg_per_fix_millicents) OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_date) > 0 THEN ((cost_avg_per_fix_millicents::float / LAG(cost_avg_per_fix_millicents) OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_date)) - 1) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS "value" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 'Fix Growth' AS "metric", CASE WHEN fix_total_runs > 0 AND LAG(fix_total_runs) OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_date) > 0 THEN ((fix_total_runs::float / LAG(fix_total_runs) OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_date)) - 1) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS "value" FROM capacity_metrics ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1
